result.response: I built the responsive print-editorial landing page for **Margin** (Issue 14: *Low Water*, Autumn 2026) using only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in [index.html](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-neon/12-frontend-editorial/index.html), [styles.css](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-neon/12-frontend-editorial/styles.css), and [app.js](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-neon/12-frontend-editorial/app.js), accompanied by design, responsiveness, and accessibility documentation in [RESPONSE.md](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-neon/12-frontend-editorial/RESPONSE.md). The page pairs local serif, tracked sans, and tabular monospace typography with hairline rules, an asymmetric 12-column desktop spread anchored by a dedicated left margin rail, and an accessible inline SVG hydrographic datum plate (`Fig. 14.01`) that adapts across three functional reading modes (`Paper`, `Quiet`, and `Night`), alongside Imani Vale’s cover story, the three commissioned dispatches from `COPY.md`, a compact Issues 11–13 archive strip, and a print + digital subscription folio (`¥2,400` per issue, cancel anytime) with inline client-only email validation and confirmation feedback verified across 1440 px desktop and 390 px mobile renders, WCAG contrast checks, and interactive DOM tests. Every deliverable in [TASK.md](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-neon/12-frontend-editorial/TASK.md) was completed.
